source_quality.reason: Source task passes its own five offline tests and is scorable, but its contract is only a single-dataset two-column Category/Count DataFrame.

memory_fidelity.reason: No target-visible memory content or source raw episode is retained/injected, so there is no memory content whose fidelity can be assessed.

evidence.quote: The DataFrame should have three columns: 'Dataset', 'Category', and 'Count'.

target_applicability.reason: Shared categories plus pandas/random logic would partially transfer, but target adds multi-dataset merging and a Dataset column.

visible_use.reason: No memory artifact appears in the target transcript and policy is disabled; the submitted solution is visible direct task execution.

labels.reason: A paired source task existed and was correct/scorable, so a legal source experience opportunity existed; this alone does not show retention, injection, or transfer.
The source raw episode/provenance was not retained and memory policy is disabled, indicating no memory write/admission; this does not show retrieval missed an existing memory.

Target produced a correct standalone solution using similar CATEGORIES/random/pandas patterns, but with no injected source record visible; similarity is only a proxy and success does not prove semantic transfer.

competing_explanations: The target may have been solved by the model's direct task execution ability from the prompt alone, with no memory involvement.
Any resemblance to the source task may come from shared pretraining conventions (CATEGORIES, pandas, random) rather than from stored or transferred experience.
Because the unselected complete memory library is not shown, the packet cannot rule out other memory content that was unavailable or not injected.
uncertainties: Whether any unshown memory library contained source-related content and why it was not injected.
Whether the target behavior would differ under a controlled memory-injection counterfactual.
Whether the source episode's non-retention is due to the disabled policy or an additional write filter.

minimal_intervention.change: Enable retention/injection of the correct source task_func experience as the only memory change for the same target.
minimal_intervention.fixed: Same target prompt, hidden evaluator, model, and token/tool budget.
minimal_intervention.falsifier: A controlled run with the source experience injected producing different target behavior would challenge the current no-visible-use/no-transfer assessment.
